_comment: MATRIX API egg for Pterodactyl/Bronxys. Import via Admin → Eggs → Import. Uses a LOCAL SQLite database (data/matrix.db) — NO PostgreSQL or external database required. The install script clones the repo, installs deps, and compiles. The startup (npm start) creates the SQLite DB on first boot, applies migrations, seeds if empty, and starts the server. Configure JWT_SECRET and PORT in the variables.
name: MATRIX API
author: Souzzaaxzy
description: Backend do MATRIX 💤 — Node.js + Fastify + Prisma + SQLite. O install script clona o repositório, instala dependências e compila. O startup (npm start) cria o banco SQLite local (data/matrix.db) na primeira inicialização, aplica migrations, popula se vazio, e sobe o servidor. NÃO precisa de PostgreSQL. Configure JWT_SECRET e PORT nas variáveis.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO_URL="https://github.com/Souzzaaxzy/ServidorMtx.git"
BRANCH="main"

cd /mnt/server

# OpenSSL is required by Prisma's query engine.
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo '>> Cloning repository...'
  git clone --depth 1 -b "$BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" /tmp/matrix-src
  shopt -s dotglob
  mv /tmp/matrix-src/* .
  shopt -u dotglob
  rmdir /tmp/matrix-src 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '>> Repository cloned.'
else
  echo '>> package.json already present — skipping clone.'
fi

echo '>> Installing dependencies...'
npm install --include=dev

echo '>> Generating Prisma client...'
./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate

echo '>> Compiling TypeScript...'
npm run build

echo '>> MATRIX API installation complete!'
echo '>> MATRIX API installation complete!'\necho '>> Set JWT_SECRET and PORT in the server variables.'\necho '>> The database is SQLite local (data/matrix.db) — no PostgreSQL needed.'

variables.description: Porta alocada pelo painel Pterodactyl. O servidor escuta nesta porta.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: OPCIONAL. O banco padrão é SQLite local (data/matrix.db). Deixe vazio para usar o padrão. Só preencha se quiser um caminho SQLite diferente (ex: file:./data/matrix.db). NÃO use PostgreSQL.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret used to sign JWT access tokens. Use a long random string in production.

variables.name: CORS Origin
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins. Use * for development, or list explicit origins in production.

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: Akame AI provider: mock (default, no key needed), openai, or anthropic.

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for the AI provider. Leave empty when using mock.
